## Version and mode
Code/config version; OS/Python/browser; offline, live model, real test ERP/MES or replay.

## Minimal synthetic reproduction
Input, selected evidence IDs, exact steps and expected/observed states. Replace real names and business details. Never include API keys, cookies or authorization headers.

## Evidence and external effects
Sanitized error code and relevant trace excerpt. Were ERP/MES records created? Was the outcome unknown? Do not retry an uncertain write merely to reproduce it.

## Impact
Clarification failure, wrong plan, stale approval, duplicate action, inaccessible control or other issue. State what was actually verified and what remains unknown.
